她双手捂住胸口，脸颊烧得通红，心跳如鼓。
月光洒在她身上，她轻轻一笑，把自己整颗心都交给了这份温柔。

She covers her chest with her hands, her cheeks flushed, her heart pounding.
Moonlight shines upon her, and she smiles softly, surrendering her entire heart to this tenderness.
